summary: Learn to assess service needs, prioritize healthcare innovations, and draft an implementation roadmap. Explore the five-day course and its practical outputs.
lede: Healthcare strategy and innovation planning helps care teams turn service challenges into priorities and practical improvement proposals. Designed for healthcare planners, service managers, and clinical or administrative teams, the course builds skills in assessing service needs, comparing improvement options, planning small-scale tests, and preparing implementation roadmaps and executive briefings.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who shape healthcare services, assess service needs, or help turn care-improvement proposals into operational plans. It is designed for healthcare education and training consulting professionals as well as public, private, and nonprofit care teams.
modules: Lean Startup Tests for Care Ideas
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with healthcare service delivery and common service-planning responsibilities is useful. No coding or programming is required.
